what_works: Numbered project carousel (01-05) borrows directly from Swiss editorial pagination — index becomes the navigation. Strict grid, generous whitespace, sans-serif throughout — nothing decorative survives.
what_does_not_translate: Portfolio-carousel structure assumes a curated body of work; for contractors, the indexing pattern (01/02/03 as section markers) is what transfers.
type_observations: Single sans-serif family across the whole site — display, body, navigation. Hierarchy from size and weight only.
